-- Pacientes vinculados via assignments
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.therapistUserId as legacyTherapistId,
       CASE WHEN p.therapistUserId = 24840035 THEN 'SIM' ELSE 'NÃO' END as isLegacyTherapist
FROM patients p
JOIN patient_therapist_assignments pta ON pta.patientId = p.id
WHERE pta.therapistUserId = 24840035
LIMIT 20;
